models.title: Aggregate net deferred tax asset position
models.summary: The disclosure subtracts the deferred tax liabilities from deferred tax assets net of allowance to show an aggregate net deferred tax asset.

relationship.original_equation: Aggregate net deferred tax asset position = deferred tax assets after allowance − deferred tax liabilities
relationship.translation_notes: All values are same-date balances in one currency; references convert USD millions into individual USD.

variables.definition: signed aggregate net deferred tax asset position
variables.context: Same entity or disclosed consolidation scope, measurement date, currency and tax-accounting basis

assumptions: Both inputs are nonnegative positive magnitudes, measured on the same date and for a consistent disclosed entity scope.
This calculation is an aggregate analytical difference; presentation as a single balance-sheet amount additionally requires applicable offset criteria.
limitations: A positive result denotes an aggregate net asset; a negative result denotes an aggregate net liability.
Offsetting on the balance sheet is not automatic: under the cited AASB 112 criteria it depends on legally enforceable rights, the tax authority and taxable entity or relevant settlement conditions.
Distinct tax jurisdictions and entities may require separate reported assets and liabilities even when their aggregate difference is calculable.
